document_scope: Entire92-page gazette issue; contains Decree320 and other instruments. Do not index all issue text as Decree320.
findings: Article12(2)(a) directs treaty-country investments to the applicable treaty.

Article12(2)(b) addresses non-treaty-country investments: b2 includes tax paid abroad or paid on behalf, and specified exempted/reduced foreign tax; not merely an unconditional direct withholding credit.
b3 requires supplemental filing after later foreign tax payment; b5 specifies recognition period and prohibits offsetting foreign project losses/profits against domestic profits/losses.
Article12(2)(c) contains separate allocated top-up-tax credit provisions with a combined cap.
required_correction: Replace claim that implementing decree is absent and direct-credit-only assumption. Model treaty route, actual payment/timing and applicable relief separately; source admission alone is insufficient.
limitations: Review of selected original provisions, not all later corrigenda/amendments or a completed credit calculator.
